sources.entry: Operational.co - Receive alerts in a live timeline from your product. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Operational.co is an open-source event tracking tool that sends alerts from your product into a live timeline, with push notifications and webhook action buttons.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Operational as an event tracking tool for monitoring signups, webhooks, cronjobs and similar events. Critical events can trigger push notifications to a phone or the web app. Events can carry contexts, which let you group related events (events-in-events) and bundle logs. Action buttons can trigger webhooks. It is offered as a hosted service or self-hosted, and the web app works as a progressive web app on mobile. The README also mentions a bootstrap command for creating draft blog posts in the marketing website, which is a side tool for the project itself.
use_cases: monitor signups and cronjobs in a live feed
get push alerts for critical product events
track webhook activity for a tech product
self-host an event alerting timeline on a VPS
how_to_run: Self-hosting options are described in the docs (Render.com, Docker images, video guides); the README does not give exact commands.
For the blog bootstrap script: set OPENROUTER_API_KEY in website/.env or the shell environment.
npm --workspace website run bootstrap-article -- --title="My Article Title"
notable: Live timeline of product events with push notifications on phone or web
Contexts let complex events be grouped as events-in-events
Action buttons trigger webhooks directly from an event
Runs without ClickHouse in the open-source version
Monorepo with app, backend, website and shared npm packages
caveats: ClickHouse is optional, but MySQL 8.x and Node.js are required for the stack
The README does not describe the hosted service's pricing or limits
Self-hosting setup details are in external docs, not the README
